description: P0 CRITICAL FIX: Restore Citizen→Community integration. Landing page promises citizens can access community discussions, but Citizen interface has zero navigation to /community. A route trap at CitizenApp.tsx line 180 shows 'unavailable' stub instead of linking to working Community features. This is a broken user-facing promise affecting all citizen users.
steps: 1. Read frontend/src/redesign/pages/CitizenApp.tsx lines 103-130 to understand CitizenShell navigation structure and existing links (Home, Fire Map, Report, My Reports, Stay safe).
2. Add navigation link to /community in CitizenShell desktop header (after 'Stay safe' link, before user menu). Use existing link pattern and styling.
3. Add 'Community' to mobile bottom tabs navigation (lines 120-130). Consider replacing 'Fire Map' tab if space constrained (Fire Map is currently placeholder per P1-4).
4. Remove route trap at line 180: Delete the line 'if (path.startsWith('/citizen/community')) return <CitizenUnavailablePage .../>'. This intercepts community routes and shows stub page.

5. Verify that authenticated citizens already have PUBLIC_ROLES authorization to access /community (read frontend/src/redesign/pages/PublicPortal.tsx CommunityPage, confirm community_user() dependency allows citizen role).
6. Update landing page promise if needed (frontend/src/redesign/pages/PublicPortal.tsx PublicLandingPage) to accurately reflect delivered features.
acceptance_criteria: Citizen users see 'Community' link in desktop header navigation
Citizen users see 'Community' in mobile bottom tabs (or accessible via menu)
Clicking 'Community' navigates to /community and loads discussion board with posts and chat
Authenticated citizens can create posts (POST /api/community/posts works)
Authenticated citizens can send chat messages (POST /api/community/chat works)
Navigation back to /citizen from /community works via header links
No 'unavailable' stub page appears when accessing community features
Landing page Citizen card description matches delivered features
verification: Manual testing: Navigate to /citizen as authenticated citizen, verify 'Community' link visible in header and mobile tabs
Click 'Community' link, verify /community page loads with discussion board and chat interface
Create a test post, verify it appears in feed (tests POST /api/community/posts and role authorization)
Send a test chat message, verify it appears in chat (tests POST /api/community/chat and rate limiting)
Navigate back to /citizen via header links, verify citizen dashboard loads
Test on mobile viewport (DevTools responsive mode): Verify Community accessible via bottom tabs or menu
Verify no route trap: Attempt to navigate to /citizen/community (if any links remain), ensure no 'unavailable' page
Cross-browser test: Chrome, Firefox, Safari (desktop and mobile viewports)
findings: COMPLETED: Modified frontend/src/redesign/pages/CitizenApp.tsx. Changes: (1) Updated CitizenShell navigation links array - replaced Fire Map with Community, pointing to /community route with icon ◉. (2) Removed Fire Map from mobile bottom tabs, added Community instead. (3) Removed route trap at line 180 that intercepted /citizen/community paths with unavailable stub. Citizens now have direct navigation to working Community features (/community). Build verified successfully. No backend changes required - citizens already have PUBLIC_ROLES authorization for community endpoints.
